text: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all administrative accounts that access production systems?
Were at least 90% of critical security patches applied within the organisation's required SLA window during the audit period?
Are all production servers running operating system versions that are still within vendor support (i.e. not end-of-life)?
Is security-event log retention configured to meet or exceed the organisation's internal minimum retention policy?
Is alerting configured to detect anomalous outbound data transfer volumes?
Has the incident response plan been reviewed within the organisation's required annual review cycle?
Was an incident response tabletop exercise or simulated incident drill conducted within the preceding 12 months?
Have all identified high-severity vulnerabilities been remediated within the organisation's internal SLA?
Is data encrypted at rest across all storage locations, including offsite backup media?
Do all active third-party vendor contracts in scope include a data breach notification clause?
Did the audit scope include the organisation's cloud infrastructure hosted with its primary IaaS provider?
Was the vulnerability scan performed using an authenticated scanning methodology?
